period_note: Balance-sheet-free, income-statement-only interim snapshot -- Solo/Standalone presumed (see sources.json). Recovered via a Wayback Machine capture of DSE's OWN company page (dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=PUBALIBANK), NOT the bank's site -- the technique proven on RUPALIBANK, applied here for the first time to PUBALIBANK. This vintage of the table (titled 'Financial Performance: <year>', pre-2016) gives only Turn Over, Net Profit After Tax (Continuing Operations), Basic/Diluted EPS and NAV per share, ALL CUMULATIVE FROM JAN 1 per the table's own column headers (Q1=3 Months, Q2=6 Months, Q3=9 Months) -- no period-end market price is given in this table vintage (the top-of-page 'Last Trade' price reflects the capture date, not the quarter-end, so it is not usable and not recorded). Sourced from DSE's (dsebd.org) own company-page interim table, NOT the bank's own site (pubalibangla.com, Cloudflare-blocked). Solo/Standalone basis presumed, consistent with this bank's established series basis, but not explicitly labeled solo vs consolidated on the DSE page itself -- flagged as an assumption, not a confirmed fact (same caveat documented for RUPALIBANK's use of this identical source type). Cross-validated against an independent second Wayback capture one month later (2013-01-15, same 'Financial Performance: 2012' table, identical values -- see pubalibank-dse-interim-tables-2011-2026.txt). Q2/Q3 EPS reconcile cleanly against the 838.451mn share count on record for this year (1238.17/838.451=1.477; 1336.5/838.451=1.594). Q1's Basic EPS (0.680) does NOT reconcile against either the old (670.761mn, implying 0.905) or new (838.451mn, implying 0.724) share count -- implies ~892.6mn shares, not matching any independently known count for this bank at this time. Recorded as reported per this dataset's 'prefer contemporaneous, don't silently correct' rule; cause not independently determined (unlike 2011/2014's cleaner bonus-timing explanation, this one does not fit that pattern neatly).
